# Guildford Islamic Cultural Center (GICC)

GICC is a mosque and community centre serving Guildford and Surrey, British Columbia.

Canonical site: https://www.giccmasjid.org/
Prayer times: https://www.giccmasjid.org/prayer-times/
Programs: https://www.giccmasjid.org/programs/
Community calendar: https://www.giccmasjid.org/calendar/
Request GICC space: https://www.giccmasjid.org/event-request/
Contact: https://www.giccmasjid.org/contact/
Donate: https://www.giccmasjid.org/donate/

Contact: info@giccmasjid.org · 604-670-6732
Address: 15290 103A Ave #101, Surrey, BC V3R 7P8, Canada
